description: Get the details of a hotel bookable for day use on Stayflex: where it is and how to get there, star category and guest rating, the day-use packages it sells on a given date with their lowest prices (taxes included), room types and their capacity, booking rules (arrival hours, minimum notice), cancellation terms, and links to its Stayflex page. Identify the hotel by the slug or id returned by search_day_use, or by its name. Live availability for a precise time slot comes from search_day_use.

date.description: Day used for the packages and prices, YYYY-MM-DD (Paris local date). Defaults to today in Paris.

hotel.description: Hotel slug or id from search_day_use (e.g. "sheraton-paris-cdg-airport-tremblay-en-france"), or the hotel name.

language.description: Language of the Stayflex web pages linked in the result: "en" (default) or "fr".

name: get_hotel
title: Get Stayflex hotel details
